title: Autoadopt approval funnel with incremental traffic partitioning for Optimize recommendations
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: Teams receive Optimize suggestions (batching and KV-cache profiles) that can materially reduce cost but occasionally increase tail latency or cause correctness regressions for a small subset of routes. Current manual apply flow is slow and error-prone. Goal: build an approval funnel that safely autoadopts vetted Optimize suggestions by progressively shifting traffic and providing an operator bailpoint and automated rollback runway if telemetry signals regressions. This ticket covers design and implementation of the funnel, traffic partitioning strategy, operator approval UX hooks, and a replayable rollback plan.
acceptance_criteria: Support a 4-stage traffic partitioning plan (0%, 5%, 25%, 100%) that can be applied per-route or per-customer
Automated preflight simulation step that runs suggestion in sandbox with sampled replay of recent traffic and produces a cost/latency/quality delta report
Approval funnel UI/API where suggestions are staged to: suggested -> queued -> staged_active -> promoted_or_rolled_back
Operator bailpoint that halts progression for routes with latency p95 increase > 15% or error-rate increase > 0.5%
Graceful rollback runway that scales traffic back over configurable windows (e.g., 5m -> 1m -> 30s) and emits a post-mortem template to observer teams
End-to-end telemetry dashboard for the funnel with per-stage metrics and alert hooks integrated to PagerDuty and Ops runbook links
implementation_notes: Control plane: new 'apply_plan' resource storing stages, percentages, escalation policies, and audit metadata
Routing: percentage partitioning implemented via lightweight traffic-split middleware using consistent hashing and token annotations to avoid pod restarts
Preflight: replay harness that can run suggestions against a sandbox model and produce structured diffs for outputs (schema, token-level changes)
Telemetry: evaluation windows of 2m with aggregated metrics (p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate, cost per 1k tokens, quality deltas) and a confidence estimator from simulation variance
API: endpoints to create/read/apply/abort an apply_plan plus operator actions and audit-event hooks for SSO-backed approvals
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: partitioning may bias request shapes (e.g., long prompts more likely to hit stage routes). Mitigation: use stratified sampling by prompt length, model family, and customer label during simulation and early stages.
Risk: noisy telemetry triggers spurious rollbacks. Mitigation: require sustained signal for two consecutive evaluation windows and implement a hysteresis multiplier on thresholds.
Risk: structured-output regressions may be subtle. Mitigation: add schema-aware diffs and mark suggestions that mutate schemas as manual-approval-only.
Risk: enterprise tenants need control. Mitigation: add per-organization opt-out flag and allow admin policy to reject auto-adopt plans.
Risk: audit & compliance gaps. Mitigation: emit immutable approval and rollback events to the audit log and surface exportable post-mortem templates.
